name: Lincoln County, OK
findings: Lincoln County has 73 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lincoln County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Lincoln County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 63% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Lincoln County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 63% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 63% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 social and fraternal organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.
